# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r load_dependencies}
# Load required packages
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, data.table, assertthat, readr, openxlsx)

# Load helper functions
source(here("R", "2-analysis", "utils_analysis.R"))
```

```{r}
# Initialize filenames
swl_wrist_info_filename <- "swl_weekly_collated_wrist_actinet_20260330.csv"
swl_thigh_info_filename <- "swl_weekly_collated_thigh_enmo_20260330.csv"
swl_wrist_weekly_summaries_filename <- "swl_wrist_weekly_summaries.csv"
swl_thigh_weekly_summaries_filename <- "swl_thigh_weekly_summaries.csv"

raine_wrist_info_filename <- "raine_weekly_collated_wrist_actinet_20260330.csv"
raine_hip_info_filename <- "raine_weekly_collated_hip_enmo_20260330.csv"
raine_wrist_weekly_summaries_filename <- "raine_wrist_weekly_summaries.csv"
raine_hip_weekly_summaries_filename <- "raine_hip_weekly_wakinghours_summaries.csv"

raine_ism_ids_filename <- "raine_idle_sleep_mode_ids.txt"

output_swl_qced_filename <- "swl_qced_phenotypes.csv"
output_raine_qced_filename <- "raine_qced_phenotypes.csv"

# Create output directories if they don't exist
invisible(lapply(c(
  here("output", "intermediate"),
  here("output", "prepared", "tables")
), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
```

# Load and prep SWL data

```{r}
# Load SWL data
dat_swl_wrist_info <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "derived_accelerometry", swl_wrist_info_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_swl_thigh_info <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "derived_accelerometry", swl_thigh_info_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_swl_wrist <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_wrist_weekly_summaries_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_swl_thigh <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_thigh_weekly_summaries_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Prep info relevant to QC
dat_swl_wrist_info <- prepare_info(dat_swl_wrist_info)
dat_swl_thigh_info <- prepare_info(dat_swl_thigh_info)

# Merge into one data frame
dat_swl_wrist <- merge(dat_swl_wrist_info,
                       dat_swl_wrist,
                       by = c("filename", "pid"),
                       all = TRUE)

dat_swl_thigh <- merge(dat_swl_thigh_info,
                       dat_swl_thigh, 
                       by = c("filename", "pid"),
                       all = TRUE)

rm(dat_swl_wrist_info, dat_swl_thigh_info)

# If PID duplicated, keep one with later dates of wear
# (In some cases, the activPAL device malfunctioned and participants were
# invited to repeat measurements using both devices.)
dat_swl_wrist <- fix_duplicates(dat_swl_wrist, dat_swl_thigh)
dat_swl_thigh <- fix_duplicates(dat_swl_thigh, dat_swl_wrist)

# Sanity checks
assert_that(!anyNA(dat_swl_wrist$calibration_ok),
            msg = "Some rows in dat_swl_wrist contain NA calibration_ok values")

assert_that(!anyNA(dat_swl_thigh$calibration_ok),
            msg = "Some rows in dat_swl_thigh contain NA calibration_ok values")
```

# Load and prep Raine data

```{r}
# Load Raine data
dat_raine_wrist_info <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "derived_accelerometry", raine_wrist_info_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_hip_info <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "derived_accelerometry", raine_hip_info_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_wrist <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_wrist_weekly_summaries_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_hip <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_hip_weekly_summaries_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Prep info relevant to QC
dat_raine_wrist_info <- prepare_info(dat_raine_wrist_info)
dat_raine_hip_info <- prepare_info(dat_raine_hip_info)

# Merge into one data frame
dat_raine_wrist <- merge(dat_raine_wrist_info,
                         dat_raine_wrist,
                         by = c("filename", "pid"),
                         all = TRUE)

dat_raine_hip <- merge(dat_raine_hip_info,
                       dat_raine_hip,
                       by = c("filename", "pid"),
                       all = TRUE)

rm(dat_raine_wrist_info, dat_raine_hip_info)

# If PID duplicated, keep one with later dates of wear
dat_raine_wrist <- fix_duplicates(dat_raine_wrist, dat_raine_hip)
dat_raine_hip <- fix_duplicates(dat_raine_hip, dat_raine_wrist)

# Load idle sleep mode IDs
ism_ids <- readLines(here("output", 
                          "derived_accelerometry", 
                          raine_ism_ids_filename))
ism_ids <- sub("_.*", "", ism_ids)
dat_raine_wrist <- dat_raine_wrist %>%
  mutate(is_ism = if_else(pid %in% ism_ids, 1, 0))

# Sanity checks
assert_that(!anyNA(dat_raine_wrist$calibration_ok),
            msg = "Some rows in dat_raine_wrist contain NA calibration_ok values")

assert_that(!anyNA(dat_raine_hip$calibration_ok),
            msg = "Some rows in dat_raine_hip contain NA calibration_ok values")
```

# Make quality-related exclusions

## SWL

```{r}
# Initialise tables to record participant exclusions
tab_exc_swl_wrist <- data.frame(reason = "Starting cohort",
                                n_remaining = nrow(dat_swl_wrist),
                                n_excluded = NA,
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tab_exc_swl_thigh <- data.frame(reason = "Starting cohort",
                                n_remaining = nrow(dat_swl_thigh),
                                n_excluded = NA,
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Exclude participants whose device could not be calibrated
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_wrist, 
                        dat_swl_wrist, 
                        calibration_ok != 1, 
                        "Failed calibration")
tab_exc_swl_wrist <- res$tab
dat_swl_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_thigh, 
                        dat_swl_thigh, 
                        calibration_ok != 1, 
                        "Failed calibration")
tab_exc_swl_thigh <- res$tab
dat_swl_thigh <- res$df

# Exclude participants with insufficient wear time
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_wrist, 
                        dat_swl_wrist, 
                        wear_time_hours < 72 | covers_24h_ok != 1 | is.na(num_days), 
                        "Insufficient wear time")
tab_exc_swl_wrist <- res$tab
dat_swl_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_thigh, 
                        dat_swl_thigh,
                        num_days < 3 | is.na(num_days),
                        "Insufficient wear time")
tab_exc_swl_thigh <- res$tab
dat_swl_thigh <- res$df

# Exclude participants with implausible values
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_wrist, 
                        dat_swl_wrist, 
                        overall_activity_mean > 100, 
                        "Implausible values")
tab_exc_swl_wrist <- res$tab
dat_swl_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_swl_thigh,
                        dat_swl_thigh,
                        overall_activity_mean > 100, # Just being conservative
                        "Implausible values")
tab_exc_swl_thigh <- res$tab
dat_swl_thigh <- res$df

# Merge SWL wrist and thigh data frames
dat_swl <- merge(dat_swl_wrist,
                 dat_swl_thigh,
                 by = "pid",
                 all = FALSE,
                 suffixes = c("_wrist", "_thigh"))

# Print results
print(tab_exc_swl_wrist, row.names = FALSE)
print(tab_exc_swl_thigh, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nFinal paired valid data: n =", nrow(dat_swl), "\n")

# Sanity check
assert_that(!anyNA(dat_swl), msg = "Some columns in dat_swl contain NA values")
```

## Raine Study Gen1

```{r}
# Initialise tables to record participant exclusions
tab_exc_raine_wrist <- data.frame(reason = "Starting cohort",
                                  n_remaining = nrow(dat_raine_wrist),
                                  n_excluded = NA,
                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tab_exc_raine_hip <- data.frame(reason = "Starting cohort",
                                n_remaining = nrow(dat_raine_hip),
                                n_excluded = NA,
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Exclude participants with idle sleep mode activated
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_wrist, 
                        dat_raine_wrist, 
                        is_ism == 1, 
                        "Idle sleep mode")
tab_exc_raine_wrist <- res$tab
dat_raine_wrist <- res$df

# Exclude participants whose device could not be calibrated
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_wrist, 
                        dat_raine_wrist, 
                        calibration_ok == 0, 
                        "Failed calibration")
tab_exc_raine_wrist <- res$tab
dat_raine_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_hip, 
                        dat_raine_hip, 
                        calibration_ok == 0, 
                        "Failed calibration")
tab_exc_raine_hip <- res$tab
dat_raine_hip <- res$df


# Exclude participants with insufficient wear time
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_wrist, 
                        dat_raine_wrist, 
                        wear_time_hours < 72 | covers_24h_ok != 1 | is.na(num_days), 
                        "Insufficient wear time")
tab_exc_raine_wrist <- res$tab
dat_raine_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_hip, 
                        dat_raine_hip,
                        num_days < 3 | is.na(num_days),
                        "Insufficient wear time")
tab_exc_raine_hip <- res$tab
dat_raine_hip <- res$df

# Exclude participants with implausible values
res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_wrist, 
                        dat_raine_wrist, 
                        overall_activity_mean > 100 | mvpa_mean > 6, # MVPA thresh because Visual inspection revealed problematic file
                        "Implausible values")
tab_exc_raine_wrist <- res$tab
dat_raine_wrist <- res$df

res <- track_exclusions(tab_exc_raine_hip,
                        dat_raine_hip,
                        overall_activity_mean > 70 | overall_activity_counts_mean > 2690 | mvpa_mean > 6, # MVPA thresh because Visual inspection revealed problematic file
                        "Implausible values")
tab_exc_raine_hip <- res$tab
dat_raine_hip <- res$df

# Merge Raine wrist and hip data frames
dat_raine <- merge(dat_raine_wrist,
                   dat_raine_hip,
                   by = "pid",
                   all = FALSE,
                   suffixes = c("_wrist", "_hip"))

# Print results
print(tab_exc_raine_wrist, row.names = FALSE)
print(tab_exc_raine_hip, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nFinal paired valid data: n =", nrow(dat_raine), "\n")

# Sanity check
assert_that(!anyNA(dat_raine), 
            msg = "Some columns in dat_raine contain NA values")
```

# Save output files

```{r}
# Save data frames to CSV files
out_path <- here("output", "intermediate", output_swl_qced_filename)
write_csv(dat_swl, out_path)
cat("QCed SWL data saved to:", out_path, "\n")

out_path <- here("output", "intermediate", output_raine_qced_filename)
write_csv(dat_raine, out_path)
cat("QCed Raine data saved to:", out_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Initialise helper variables
tabs <- list(tab_exc_swl_wrist  = tab_exc_swl_wrist,
             tab_exc_swl_thigh  = tab_exc_swl_thigh,
             tab_exc_raine_wrist= tab_exc_raine_wrist,
             tab_exc_raine_hip  = tab_exc_raine_hip)

titles <- c("SWL wrist-worn Axivity AX3",
            "SWL thigh-worn activPAL3",
            "Raine Study Gen1 wrist-worn ActiGraph GT3X+",
            "Raine Study Gen1 hip-worn ActiGraph GT3X+")

start_cols <- c(1, 5, 9, 13)

# Create workbook and worksheet
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Exclusion Tables")

# Write titles (row 1) and tables (from row 2)
for (i in seq_along(tabs)) {
  sc <- start_cols[i]
  writeData(wb, 
            sheet = 1, 
            x = titles[i], 
            startCol = sc, 
            startRow = 1)
  writeData(wb, 
            sheet = 1, 
            x = tabs[[i]], 
            startCol = sc, 
            startRow = 2, 
            rowNames = FALSE)
}

# Make titles bold
title_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
addStyle(wb, sheet = 1, style = title_style,
         rows = 1, cols = start_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)

# Auto-adjust column widths for each block
for (sc in start_cols) {
  setColWidths(wb, sheet = 1, cols = sc:(sc + 2), widths = "auto")
}

# Add paired valid participant summary at bottom
summary_row <- max(vapply(tabs, nrow, integer(1))) + 5
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Study = c("SWL", "Raine Study Gen1"),
  Paired_valid_participants = c(nrow(dat_swl), nrow(dat_raine)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
writeData(wb,
          sheet = 1,
          x = "Paired valid participants summary",
          startCol = 1,
          startRow = summary_row - 1)
addStyle(wb,
         sheet = 1,
         style = title_style,
         rows = summary_row - 1,
         cols = 1,
         gridExpand = TRUE)
writeData(wb,
          sheet = 1,
          x = summary_df,
          startCol = 1,
          startRow = summary_row)

# Save workbook
out_path <- here("output", "prepared", "tables", "exclusion_table.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Exclusion tables saved to:", out_path, "\n")
```
